summary: Real, specific Chess Club content confirmed throughout (Maya Patel #1/1500 pts, Thursday club night, Season 2026 export scope). The weekday-header fix (CJM.12/14) and the disabled-Save hint fix (CJM.10) both hold cleanly on this fourth community. New real finding: raw ISO-8601 timestamps/dates ('Updated 2026-08-08T10:00:00Z', calendar day chips '2026-08-13') are never humanized -- a genuinely separate gap from CJM.15's boolean/hyphen fix, since the identifier-detection regex requires a leading letter and ISO dates start with a digit, so they never even reach the humanizer. FAB-occlusion findings across all 5 screens are the same known evidence-coverage pattern already established twice this session (mid-scroll screenshots, not true-max-scroll) -- not re-verified as a regression given CJM.13 already proven live multiple times. Remaining findings (unhumanized 'Delta' field key, chip/field duplication, '2 roles' ambiguity, admin capability coverage, nav tab clipping) are minor UX polish, deferred.

newFindingRequiringFutureWork.title: ISO-8601 dates/timestamps rendered verbatim -- a distinct, unaddressed gap from CJM.15
newFindingRequiringFutureWork.description: humanizeIdentifierValue()/_looksLikeIdentifierValue() only recognize word-like identifiers (must start with a letter); an ISO date string like '2026-08-08T10:00:00Z' starts with a digit and never matches, so it passes straight through as raw text. This is architecturally different from CJM.15's boolean/hyphen fix -- it needs real date parsing and human formatting (e.g. 'Aug 8' / 'Thu, Aug 13'), not a regex extension. Confirmed on both the ranking card's 'Updated' chip and the calendar's day-selector chips.
newFindingRequiringFutureWork.deferralReason: More complex than a regex tweak (needs a real date formatter across date/datetime/time field types); deferred to a future CJM ticket rather than implemented mid-walkthrough given this session's already very large scope. Tracked here, not silently dropped.
